stable.notes: Start work is pinned beside Work's session row: with more session cards than fit, they fade and slide under it instead of being cut off, and the pinned column shows a soft edge only when cards run under it. Includes 0.5.244's Work dashboard. Pairs with server 6.57.1.

notice.title: Right-click the pet
notice.body: Right-click the pet for Full motion, Calm motion or No motion, or to hide it. Hidden, it comes back from COS Control in the menu bar, under Session pet. The pet also shows Codex threads while they work and Cursor chats mid-turn.
